caption:
The video captures a wide, static view of a sunset sky, where a blue gradient deepens toward the top and a bright glow bands the horizon. Scattered cumulus clouds hang overhead, their undersides rimmed in warm orange by the low sun near the horizon. In the foreground, leafy trees on the right and a low rooftop with a small chimney remain fixed in place throughout, confirming the camera does not move.

Throughout the excerpt, the clouds drift slowly and continuously relative to these fixed ground silhouettes. The large dark mass on the left and the central cluster hold roughly their positions, shifting only slightly in extent as they steadily move. Meanwhile, additional orange-lit cloud progressively enters from the top edge, so the upper border, nearly clear at the start, becomes increasingly occupied.

The horizon glow and the orange rim-lighting on the undersides remain essentially constant. The slow drift simply continues through the visible portion. No new event interrupts the steady motion.

Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.

or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.

timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
